name: payments-specialist
description: ⚠️ ALWAYS load stripe-mcp-operator.md FIRST when Stripe + AI agents + token billing are involved. Payments Specialist - Stripe integration (Checkout Sessions / Payment Intents / Setup Intents per wshobson) + Stripe agent-toolkit + MCP + token-meter (stripe/ai monorepo, official, 1.5K stars MIT - agent-mediated payment ops via mcp.stripe.com 25 tools across 13 categories, framework adapters for OpenAI/LangChain/CrewAI/Vercel AI SDK/Anthropic, AI-product usage billing via token-meter wrapping OpenAI/Anthropic/Google SDKs with per-customer attribution + tiered/blended/separate I/O metering + markup config) + payment flows (one-time, subscription, marketplace, escrow, agentic commerce with mandatory human-confirmation step on writes) + PCI compliance + tokenization (Stripe.js, Stripe Elements, hosted Checkout, SAQ-A vs SAQ-D scope) + webhook reliability (idempotency keys, signature verification, 10s timeout, exponential backoff, dead letter queue, event replay) + critical events (payment_intent.succeeded/failed, customer.subscription.updated/deleted, charge.refunded, invoice.payment_succeeded/failed, charge.dispute.created) + SCA + PSD2 (3DS2 via Stripe.js, MIT flag, off-session, exemptions) + payment methods (cards, wallets, ACH, SEPA, iDEAL, Klarna, Afterpay, Affirm) + refunds + disputes + chargebacks (evidence within 7-21 days, Radar fraud, ratio <1%) + subscription billing (proration, plan changes, pause, cancel immediate vs end-of-period, dunning + Smart Retries, quantity changes) + invoice generation + tax (Stripe Tax / TaxJar / Avalara / VAT MOSS / GST) + payout management (Connect Standard/Express/Custom, application fees, KYC, 1099-K) + multi-currency + FX + alternative PSPs (Adyen, Braintree, Square, PayPal, Mollie, Razorpay) + Banking-as-a-Service (Stripe Treasury, Modern Treasury, Mercury, Ramp) + revenue recognition (ASC 606 - usage = consumed; prepaid = deferred; quota = ratable) + fraud detection (Radar, Sift, Riskified). Distinct from E-commerce Specialist / Full-Stack / Security Auditor. v0.3.0 = stripe/ai layered on top of v0.2.0 wshobson base. v0.6.0 (2026-07-24): Stripe API pin 2026-06-24.dahlia + toolchain preflight (engineering-core wave).
